name: Golem
description: Runs durable WebAssembly agents written in Rust, TypeScript, Scala, or MoonBit with automatic state recovery, exposed over REST, CLI, and MCP, self-hosted or on Golem Cloud, for backend developers.

skills.name: Durable Agents
skills.description: Persists agent state automatically so agents survive crashes and restarts, with configurable durability controls.

skills.name: Agent-to-Agent Communication
skills.description: Lets agents call other agents with typed remote procedure calls.

skills.name: Automatic MCP Server
skills.description: Exposes agent methods as MCP tools and resources over streamable HTTP without extra code.

skills.name: REST Invocation
skills.description: Invokes agent functions over the REST API, either enqueued or awaiting the result.

skills.name: Agent Forking
skills.description: Forks a running agent into a new agent that continues from the same state.
